prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: vertical mobile game scene background painting, artwork only, no UI
Primary request: a radically new luxurious SPRING FLOWER GARDEN PICNIC scene for a Chinese hotpot food tile puzzle skin named 海棠春宴. Full bleed tall portrait, aspect 720:1520. This is an open-air garden environment, not a room or a decorative wall.
Scene: Sweeping flowering pink crabapple branches form a natural asymmetrical canopy overhead, soft pale blue spring sky and delicate clouds visible throughout the upper third. A distant white painted garden fence curves across a flowering lawn; petal-strewn pale garden path recedes into softly painted garden depth. Large luxurious blush pink LINEN PICNIC CLOTH softly draped over a low round picnic table or picnic ground occupies most of central and lower canvas. Its form and gentle folds feel organic and round, not a rectangular paper panel; extremely subtle pastel pink gingham weave, soft tonal pink and lilac shadows. Few fallen petals only near edges. Small woven flower basket and bouquet at lower-left corner, rounded white ceramic teapot and pale lilac cup at lower-right corner. Tiny garden plants on outer edges. Dreamy diffuse daylight, pastel rose, white, pale blue, lilac, delicate spring light.
Game composition: logo will later overlay top center y0-150 of a1520canvas; level bar at153-222 and progress at232, keep these relatively calm. Food-card cluster will overlay center x150-540,y520-865 on720x1520 canvas: this area must be low contrast, soft pink linen with extremely subtle texture and no large petals, no props and no busy folds. Tray overlays y1125-1250 and bottom buttons y1380-1460: keep lower middle low detail and clear, place props only far corners. Paint coherent scene across whole canvas; avoid a blank rectangular wall. Show real outdoor depth at sides and above.
Style: premium richly finished painterly casual mobile game environment, tactile soft linen and petals, dimensional light and shadow, polished details but center calm. Elegant floral theme, not flat vector or webpage design.
Constraints: NO indoor structure, lanterns, top curtains or fabric valance, ornamental wooden frame, rice paper wall, twin lamps, side vases on pedestals, hotpot or copper pot, generic wooden tabletop, people, food tiles, slots, icons, buttons, badges, lettering, calligraphy, logos, readable signs, UI or watermark. Do not repeat a Chinese tavern frame.
